text:
tess: Started bringup of v6-beta-int4 at 07:05 as a 6% canary. baseline perf good but a couple of user cohorts show quality drift. want to agree a stratified rollback policy that respects cohort importance and output-distribution drift. cc @hiro @marco

hiro: can you summarize which cohorts and the primary signals?

tess: sure. two cohorts flagged: enterprise_docs (n_ctrl=6.2k n_trt=6.0k) long_answer_fidelity down 2.8% (p=0.002). consumer_chat_short (n~18k each) semantic_coherency down 1.1% (p=0.04). KL divergence between control and treatment token distributions increased 0.012 on enterprise_docs (bootstrap CI excludes 0).

marco: interesting to see KL used in the signal set. my 2c: treat enterprise cohorts as higher severity. propose a weighted gating system where cohort severity scales the trigger sensitivity.

claire: yes. propose layered rules:
- Preconditions: window=15m, require per-cohort samples >= 1k to be considered.
- Cohort severity weights: enterprise=2.0, high_volume_consumer=1.0, internal=0.8.
- Primary trigger: if weighted_delta = sum(weight * zscore_delta) across monitored metrics >= 2.0 -> rollback. zscore_delta uses historical baseline stdevs.
- Distribution drift guard: if KL_divergence >= 0.010 for any cohort with n>=1000 and KL monotonic across two windows -> rollback.
- Output-entropy guard: if average token_entropy drops >0.2 bits AND coherency metric drops OR hallucination increases >0.3% -> investigate and auto-pause expansion.
- Hysteresis: require any rollback trigger to persist for 2 consecutive 15m windows except for obvious infra regressions (latency/error) which rollback immediately.

hiro: I like severity-weighting. couple tweaks: use EWMA on zscores with lambda=0.3 to reduce sensitivity to single-window spikes. also for KL require delta > 0.010 AND p<=0.05.

marco: we should also define an "expansion-hold" state: if any trigger fires, keep canary at current traffic and block auto-promote for 6h until manual review, unless an immediate rollback is triggered.

tess: agree. also want to add a cohort blacklist for noisy cohorts (e.g., internal_experiments) so they don't count towards weighted_delta.

sre-bot: draft CLI to create the policy with parameters:
```
/safety create --model v6-beta-int4 --name stratified-weighted-gate --window 15m --min-samples 1000 --weights "enterprise:2.0,consumer:1.0,internal:0.8" --weighted-threshold 2.0 --kl-threshold 0.010:p<=0.05:monotonic:2x15m --entropy-drop 0.2 --ewma-lambda 0.3 --hysteresis 2x15m --expansion-hold 6h --blacklist internal_experiments --notify #incidents --audit true
```

claire: addendum: on KL and weighted triggers attach a small random sample of 500 examples to the audit export so product can inspect semantic changes quickly.

hiro: also log the token-level ngram shift table for any cohort that trips KL so we can spot templating/regression patterns.

marco: final suggestion: when triggering rollback, tag the model version with reason code and a TTL hold of 24h to prevent accidental re-promote, and create an automated bisect job that runs a focused A/B across top 3 subsets of that cohort to narrow root cause.

tess: sounds good. action items: 1) create the policy as drafted 2) shrink canary to 2% to run focused cohort smoke runs 3) run the EWMA-powered live evaluation for 2 windows and the targeted offline bisect job 4) reconvene with results. Ill open a rollout ticket and paste links here.

sre-bot: policy created id=stratified-weighted-3199. will alert #incidents and export audits on triggers. expansion-hold and auto-rollback logic enabled.

claire: thanks. ping when the cohort smoke completes and we have the 2-window EWMA summary. :thumbsup:

tess: will do, thanks everyone.
